notes: Modified cash basis for governmental funds; business-type activities on accrual basis. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund balance roll-forward 1,030,098 + 598,922 - 510,799 = 1,118,221; no transfers. No cash roll-forward printed: ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 776,320 (p4); certificates of deposit 336,563 in ending_investments; county treasurer cash 5,338 separate line; beginning cash not printed. The proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position right half (Sewer, Nursing Home, Total) is not in the trimmed PDF (only Electric/Water columns, p8), so business-type receipts/disbursements come from the Statement of Activities business-type lines (pp2-3): charges for services per function, miscellaneous 311 (Water other revenue, counted as a general revenue, not charges for services), interest income 25,752; 3,537,764 + 400,889 - 204,476 = 3,734,177. Proprietary cash flows from Total column (p10). Governmental net position null (cash-basis governmental activities); the Statement of Activities prints a governmental restatement of 1,337,798 (as previously reported 1,030,098, restated 2,367,896) that is not part of the fund-balance roll-forward. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), since governmental funds totals (1,118,221) differ from government-wide (2,536,220; capital assets); component unit column excluded. General Fund detail from the departmental combining statement (pp13-14), more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule (p11, not recorded). Street Fund from its budget schedule (p12; Charges for services actual 0, budget 925, not recorded). Keno fund and enterprise funds have no schedules, so no detail for them. Read pages 1-14 of 14
